open_boundaries: Host Python ast parser, whole-source hashing and constructor renderer provenance are file bindings, not Lean proofs of parsing Python.
Runtime Python name/global resolution, math module binding, builtin shadowing, mutation and monkeypatch absence are not modeled.
Python binary64 operations, literal rounding, overflow/underflow, NaN/infinity/signed zero, CPython math.fsum, libm exp/log1p/sqrt and exception behavior are not modeled.

The _need finite check and its failure branch, starred list construction, all/isfinite iteration, return dictionary/tuple allocation and gradient_norm sqrt are not included in the proposed first five-assignment numerical projection.
The _prepare path, hashes, tokenization, corpus/features/difference construction and validation must acquire separate source bindings and semantic obligations.
Training iteration, stopping/validation, artifact serialization, ranking/metrics, full source-to-model equivalence, general IR equivalence, AE equivalence and full terminal task remain open.
Qualified original exact-real optimizer convergence is prior mathematical evidence. No new source objective, source gradient or source loop convergence follows from this design.
